CineMovie v0.9.0 Changelog:

Design & Visual Refresh:
• Modernized User Interface: Refreshed card layouts, hero presentations, and section headers across the entire app for a cleaner, more premium feel.
• Visual Effects & Polish: Enhanced blur layers, backdrop glassmorphism styling, and refined micro-animations for smoother interactions.
• Typography & Spacing: Fine-tuned typography hierarchy, padding, and layout alignments across mobile, tablet, and TV displays.

Android TV Mode:
• Enhanced TV Experience: Completely revamped big-screen user experience with optimized D-pad focus routing and fluid navigation.
• Visual Focus States: Redesigned remote focus outlines with polished highlight animations for clear navigation visibility.
• TV Scrolling & Layouts: Eliminated layout reflows and stutter during rapid remote control scrolling on Android TV.

Quality & Performance:
• Overall App Quality: Comprehensive optimizations throughout the app, dramatically speeding up screen transitions and content rendering.
• DOM & Memory Efficiency: Optimized resource utilization and background component lifecycle management to ensure silky smooth 60fps playback.
• Asset Optimization: Faster asset decoding and improved caching for poster artwork and backdrop images.

Fixed:
• Design Effects & Glitches: Fixed subtle visual clipping, backdrop blur flickering, and touch ripple effect inconsistencies.
• Navigation Fixes: Resolved focus trap and back navigation issues when navigating nested modal views.
• General Stability: Fixed interface rendering quirks and stability improvements across all supported platforms.
